view-01.png.evidence: Produce stalls, stonework and wood have distinct textures and coherent shadows; thin colored routes remain visible in a densely populated market.

view-02.png.evidence: Clear top objective bars and aircraft silhouettes; deck structures supply form but soft ocean streaks and flat carrier surfaces limit depth.

view-03.png.evidence: Uncluttered coastal flight with readable HUD; hangar forms and tree shadows help, while field squares and broad grass remain blurred and flat.

view-04.png.evidence: Crisp carrier rails and raised bridge with stronger shadow create more depth; foam is visible but the long coherent ship wake visible in view-06 is absent.

view-05.png.evidence: Layered radial sparks, bloom and explosion colors integrate with detailed machinery and atmospheric cliffs; crowding obscures silhouettes beside the blast.

view-06.png.evidence: Quiet carrier scene has sharp stripes, railings and superstructure, readable objective bars, sea flecks and a distinct trailing wake; material lighting remains simple.

view-07.png.evidence: Sharp aircraft and detailed carrier survive the busy scene, but overlapping cream wings, foam and soft spark dots obscure central action.

view-08.png.evidence: Cutaway rooms show coherent warm/cool light, wall height, furniture, wood and tile materials; tactical marks remain distinguishable within the detailed plan.

view-09.png.evidence: Directional aircraft shadows and raised carrier bridge establish height; shadows are heavy dark doubles and the ship lacks the long visible wake of view-24.

view-10.png.evidence: Trees and hangars have stronger cast shadows; shoreline rocks and a softer sand transition add variety, while grass and fields remain smooth and schematic.

view-11.png.evidence: Wet reflections, rain, volumetric smoke and orange projectile lighting create rich atmosphere; dark small infantry are hard to distinguish from rubble.

view-12.png.evidence: Runway, roofs and roads read cleanly; modest tree shadows imply height but large roof and ground surfaces show little material response.

view-13.png.evidence: Aircraft shadows and bridge height strengthen volume; the scene stays soft and its ship wake is less developed than view-02.

view-14.png.evidence: Shoreline boulders, blurred sand edge and stronger building/tree shadows add depth and variety; grass remains repetitive and shadow edges are soft.

view-15.png.evidence: Sharp hangar outlines and runway markings organize the base; sparse sea flecks and tree shading add restrained depth with limited material complexity.

view-16.png.evidence: Clear plane, HUD and shoreline with sharpened base structures and scattered ocean highlights; broad fields and grass still lack tactile detail.

view-17.png.evidence: Strong directional airplane shadows supply height but add many dark duplicate silhouettes to already crowded aircraft, sparks and sea flecks.

view-18.png.evidence: Layered fog, autumn foliage, muddy ruts and weathered shed create rich depth; smoke and flashes integrate well while gray tanks blend with terrain.

view-19.png.evidence: Top objectives stay legible despite a dense aircraft ring; soft sprites and translucent particle dots obscure the carrier center and weakly describe materials.

view-20.png.evidence: Uncluttered composition and raised bridge remain readable; stronger object shadows help volume but water is soft and there is little coherent wake.

view-21.png.evidence: Added shoreline stones and deeper tree/building shadows enrich the sparse terrain; soft sand edge is plausible but large fields remain blank patches.

view-22.png.evidence: Sharp hangars with dark side faces, shoreline boulders, tracks and grounded trees give the base more physical structure; flat grass still limits richness.

view-23.png.evidence: Directional shadows give aircraft height but multiply silhouettes in the dense central swarm; soft particles and blurry wings reduce phone-size separation.

view-24.png.evidence: Cream/red aircraft are sharp against teal water, carrier rails are defined and trailing wake is visible; scattered white fragments look partly detached from waves.

view-25.png.evidence: Simple carrier composition and top objective bars are clear; tower, rails and long pale wake add form, but surfaces and water remain softly shaded.

top3_gaps: Material response remains shallow: grass, deck, roofs and water lack the texture and illumination variation visible in detailed reference scenes.
Aircraft swarms still obscure the player; stronger cast shadows increase dark silhouette clutter in views 17 and 23.
Ocean fragments and soft spark dots remain disconnected effects; some raised-bridge carrier views lose the coherent trailing wake.

visible_regressions.comparison: Against corresponding quiet/sparse carrier compositions view-06, view-24, view-02 and view-25, the coherent long ship wake is absent or much weaker; extra bridge/shadow volume does not compensate in effects polish.
Against busy views 07 and 19, stronger offset aircraft shadows create duplicate dark shapes and reduce central silhouette separation; readability drops from 6.5 to 6.

_summary.blinding_limitations: All 25 displayed images inspected. No files outside the image packet were opened, and no source mapping was consulted. Identical references and familiar aircraft/coast layouts are recognizable from the prior review; anchors were preserved. Relative visual pairings above are appearance-based, without attributing chronology or implementation.
